methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN Joint Inspection Unit publishes system-wide reports, notes and management letters issued since 1968. The reports listing at https://www.unjiu.org/content/reports is a server-rendered Drupal table with real PDF links in every row.

## Search
The site header contains a search form; the reports table itself is server-side filterable and paginated. A verified search-URL template was not captured, but on-page dropdown filters (Prepared by, Reference, Scope, Year, Type) drive server-side filtering, and pagination is server-side (9 pages). Search/paginate are therefore supported.

## Filters
Dropdown filters: Prepared by, Reference, Scope, Year, Type. These are handled server-side. Year and reference are also recoverable from the JIU/REP/{YEAR}/{N} symbol and the PDF filename.

## Download
Direct PDF. Pattern: https://www.unjiu.org/sites/www.unjiu.org/files/{filename}.pdf, filenames like jiu_rep_2026_2_english.rev__0.pdf and jiu_rep_2026_1_0.pdf. Most reports also carry 'Review Highlights' PDFs and organization-response PDFs.

## Metadata & Enrichment
No DSpace/item API. Metadata is parsed from the table row (reference symbol, title, year, type) and the filename. Enrichment mode is none.

## Limitations
Content is server-rendered so no headless browser is needed. Full capability set (search/browseAll/paginate/download) is supported through the server-rendered filterable/paginated table.
